{{Top|leg}}
'''4A8-RA-7''' was a [[Unidentified robot orderly|robot orderly]] stationed on [[Anglebay Station]], a neutral hospital station located on [[Telos IV]]. In [[17 BBY]], 4A8-RA-7 debriefed former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] after he was rebuilt as a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] at Anglebay Station.
